messages:
Maria R.: Quick sync — Q3 roadmap items: audit-log retention tiers, KMS/HSM rotation policies, and launch criteria for enterprise customers. Need a concise must-have vs nice-to-have list. cc @Penny (sec-pm) @Dmitri K.
Dmitri K.: +1. From customers I've talked to: must-haves = immutable audit trail, tenant-scoped retention config, customer-managed keys (bring-your-own), and rotation without service downtime. Nice-to-have = long-term cold archive (7y) and per-tenant export SLA.
Samir P.: Infra notes: retention tiers impact index size and cost. Proposal: default 90d hot, 365d warm, archive to cold blob at 2555d (~7y). Need support for TTL-based lifecycle + export job. Rough config sketch:
```yaml
retention:
  default_days: 90
  warm_days: 365
  archive_days: 2555
```
Penny (sec-pm): Draft launch criteria (vote please):
- LC1 (must): Redwood-managed KMS with documented rotation API + CMK support for enterprise
- LC2 (must): Immutable append-only audit log with tamper-evidence and chain-of- custody metadata
- LC3 (must): Console controls for per-tenant retention and export to S3/GCS
- LC4 (must): Migration tool (dry-run + cutover) for existing logs > 90d
- LC5 (nice): Cold-archive retrieval within 24h; 7y archival option
Please react with :thumbsup: if must-haves look right or add edits.
Ash V.: A couple of SLO questions: what are target SLAs for audit export and archive retrieval? Also error budget for migration jobs? We should avoid large migration runs causing tail latency spikes.
Qi L.: Migration design thoughts: chunked, backpressure-aware workers + per-tenant rate limits. Example CLI for dry-run/migrate:
```bash
rwdctl logs migrate --tenant acme-corp --from hot --to archive --cutover-date 2026-07-01 --dry-run\```
We also need a rollback path if we detect missing metadata.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: retention-config-service -> staging at 2026-06-20T02:00Z (sha: d3f4b1c).
legal-bot: Note from Legal: GDPR/data minimization — we cannot unilaterally retain EU user PII for 7y without lawful basis. Must add per-tenant opt-in and export/delete workflows. Also check data residency (EU customers may require archive in EU region).
Dmitri K.: Good catch @legal-bot. That means must-have: per-tenant regional archive option + API to request deletions. Also HSM rotation policy: support both automated rotation and manual M-of-N key recovery for enterprise compliance.
Penny (sec-pm): Adjusted LC list with legal items included. Can folks vote on must-have vs nice-to-have by EOD? I'll compile cost impact & risk matrix after voting.
Maria R.: Thanks all — action items: 1) Penny to finalize launch criteria and cost/risk matrix, 2) Samir + Qi to prototype migration CLI and backpressure strategy, 3) Dmitri to draft HSM rotation/CMK matrix and recovery playbook, 4) Legal to surface residency/retention constraints per region. Schedule 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to finalize prioritization. If you can't attend, leave votes in thread. (reaction :calendar:)
